name: request_security_action
description: Request execution of a security-related action in a controlled environment. Supports skill, python, and Playwright execution modes. For bot-protected targets (Akamai/Cloudflare/Datadome), escalate lightest-to-heaviest: curl_cffi inside a python action -> patchright browser engine -> camoufox browser engine (set browser_engine on spawn_agent). See skills/TEMPLATE.md for creating new skills.

target.description: IP, hostname, URL, or logical target name

engagement_id.description: Optional reporting engagement id (from create_reporting_engagement) to bind this execution to. Tag executions with the engagement they belong to so the dashboard can scope metrics per engagement, even when two engagements share the same target/scope. An unknown id is rejected.

action_type.description: Type of execution: 'skill' to invoke a skill class, 'python' to run sandbox Python code on a Kali agent, 'playwright' to run a raw Python Playwright script on a Playwright agent (NOT JavaScript), 'playwright_skill' to invoke a browser skill, 'report_skill' to invoke a reporting skill (BaseReportSkill subclass) on a reporting agent, or 'mobile_skill' to invoke a mobile static-analysis skill (BaseMobileSkill subclass, e.g. mobile.ManifestScan) on a mobile agent

skill.description: Skill class path (e.g. 'network.NmapScan'). Required when action_type is 'skill'.

arguments.description: Keyword arguments passed to the skill's run() method. Used when action_type is 'skill'.

command.description: Python code to execute. Required when action_type is 'python'.

script.description: Python source using playwright.sync_api or async_api (e.g. 'from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright'). The Playwright executor runs this with the container's Python interpreter — JavaScript/Node scripts will fail. Script must print a single JSON envelope to stdout. Required when action_type is 'playwright'.

allow_complex_tooling.description: Override planning guardrails when you intentionally want an external-tool workflow for a task that could be handled by lightweight Python.

depends_on.description: Optional prerequisite execution_ids. This execution stays queued and hidden from workers until every prerequisite COMPLETES, and is cancelled automatically if any prerequisite fails. Use it to chain dependent steps (e.g. fuzz after tech-detect) without hand-sequencing spawn/wait calls.
